title: MAK95 MCQ Five-Gate Closure and Cluster Governance
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume

metadata.outcome: A controlled MCQ workflow where every row is either repaired, grounded, deduplicated, clustered, or terminal/manual with a machine-readable reason, then merged only after validator success.

nodes.title: Load MCQ corpus, ledgers, and batch schema
nodes.content: Read MCQ markdown/CSV sources, latest five-gate ledger, batch JSON, assigned result path, and validator command.

nodes.title: Deduplicate and cluster stems/options
nodes.content: Normalize stems/options, cluster keyed-answer variants, and group by subtopic/frontmatter plus semantic near-duplicates.

nodes.title: Route each row through five gates
nodes.content: For each MCQ row, classify as repairable, needs citation-bank grounding, duplicate merge, terminal placeholder, or manual review.

nodes.title: Ground option explanations with PageIndex anchors
nodes.content: Prefer PageIndex page anchors and local evidence banks over generic web citations; reuse cluster-level citation banks for speed.

nodes.title: Write bounded result JSON only
nodes.content: Write the assigned result file without editing ledgers or canonical CSVs; include every original batch row or a valid terminal/manual status.

nodes.title: Run validator and merge dry-run
nodes.content: Run the supplied validator, then dry-run merge/fast-closure before any canonical mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Terminal rows include explicit reason and gate

edges.description: bounded workers must touch only the assigned result artifact
validator errors feed the next gate-routing pass
